title: What Is an SOP? Why It Matters for AI
description: An SOP gives people and AI tools one shared process. Learn what to include, how it prevents repeated prompting, and how to make handoffs safer.
ogDescription: A practical guide to SOPs for reliable AI workflows and handoffs.
alt: AI teams following one shared SOP
ctaLine: Choose one recurring task and write the steps people and AI should follow.
